create_segment_dataset_from_recording: create a SegmentDataset from a MEG recording using the Factory with a condition and time window
extract_epochs_with_dataset_factory: extract MEG epochs from a recording using _DatasetFactory with specified tmin and tmax parameters
build_segment_batch_for_training: build a SegmentBatch by indexing a SegmentDataset to get MEG data and features for training
get_train_valid_test_datasets: get train valid and test Datasets from study selections using get_datasets with split ratios
collate_segment_batches: collate a list of SegmentBatch instances into a single batch using the collate_fn class method
